resources.string: Ben Tech TV Stick is a media player only. It does not include or provide any channels, movies or content.
Version %1$s of Ben Tech TV Stick is available. Press \"Update\" to install it. Your settings stay as they are.
You must install version %1$s to keep using Ben Tech TV Stick. Press \"Update\".
If the installer does not open: Settings → My Fire TV → Developer options → Install unknown apps → Ben Tech TV Stick → ON.
